pages.text: $(bold)Threat level:$() variable$(br2)One is an irritation with legs. Ten is a thermal failure event. They do not stop once they find a warm body or a working heater.$(br2)$(italic)Do not call them ice silverfish. That phrase has preceded several deaths.$()

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(li)Latch on and drag your temperature down; drain stacks to a severe cap$(li)Swarm lit Thermal Heaters: less warmth, dimmer glow, faster fuel burn$(li)Spawn in later phases and burst from infested cold blocks when mined$(li)Fast, erratic movement

pages.title: Counters
pages.text: $(li)Do not let them stack$(li)A lit heater draws them off you, but then you must guard it$(li)A full EVA suit blocks the heat drain on you$(li)Expect them in packed or blue ice you mine late$(li)$(l:heating/miteaway)MiteAway$(/l) smoke keeps them out of a room
$(bold)Drops:$() Snowball$(br2)$(italic)If your heater seems weaker and is covered in tiny moving frost, you are now operating a communal buffet.$()
